question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Nominal
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"Nominal"**.
 
• **"Nominal"** means very small in amount, effect, or something being minimal. (नाममात्र का)
 
 
• **Example**:* They charge a nominal fee for the road trip.*
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is **"Excessive"** which means more than is necessary, normal, or desirable. (अत्यधिक)
 
 
• **Example**: *He was taking an excessive amount of calories.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **"Excessive".**

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liberal**: It means open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values. (उदार)
 
• **Adroit**: It means skillful or clever in using the hands or mind. (चतुर)
 
• **Identical**: It means similar in every detail or exactly alike. (एकसमान)
